question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have all correct spellings. Choose the sentence with the incorrect spelt word/ words.

options.text: I slipped the ramrod down it to make sure it was loaded, then I laid it across the turnip barrel, pointing towards pap.
But the hope in his wisdom was at length changed into dred, for no one beleived him when he said he knew no charms.
That made me pretty uneasy again, but only for a minute.
He said he would watch out, and if they tried to come any such game on him he knew of a place six or seven mile off to stow me in.

solution:
The sentence with the incorrect spelling is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"dred"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"dread"**, which means great fear or apprehension. (भय)

 
 
• **Example:** The thought of speaking in public filled him with dread.
 
 
 
• The word **"beleived"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"believed"**, which means to accept something as true; feel sure of the truth of. (विश्वास करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She believed in the goodness of people.
 
 
 
• Only in **option 2**, some of the the spellings are **incorrect**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**
